gpio_output.description: Allocate a GPIO output on any pad eligible for general allocation. The application initializes the selected pad; external load and device-select behavior is an application requirement.
guidance: Both PA5 and PA4 require initialization of the selected pin.
Every selectable pad requires initialization of the selected pin.

gpio_interrupt.description: Exclusive GPIO input with a dedicated external-line CPU interrupt on any pad eligible for general allocation; explicit edge and pull, bounded callback, start, stop and restart. One external line serves the same pad index on every port.

assumption: General allocation follows the board netlist: solder-bridge state, connector use and external circuits are not verified.
assumption_replacements: GPIO interrupt composition covers PA4/PA5 CPU delivery only, with exclusive physical EXTI4/5 ownership across any consumers. Pending edge flags can coalesce. No complete EXTI/errata/electrical, shared-line or DMA-trigger coverage.

GPIO interrupt composition covers CPU delivery only, with exclusive ownership of each physical external line across any consumers. Pending edge flags can coalesce. No complete EXTI/errata/electrical, shared-line or DMA-trigger coverage.
